title: Russian drone hits train near Ukraine-Poland border soon after dignitaries passed through
summary: A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after senior visiting officials, including the former prime ministers of the U.K. and Sweden, passed through.
contentText:
A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after senior visiting officials, including the former prime ministers of the U.K. and Sweden, passed through.

(Image credit: Ukrainian Ukrzaliznytsia Railway)
